title: Month-End Close & Adjusting Entries — Meridian Building Group
scenario: It's the close for the quarter ended 2026-03-31. Work the close checklist: record the period-end adjusting entries (accrued payroll & burden, depreciation, WIP cutoff), close net income to retained earnings, and prove the closed trial balance balances. Every number must agree to the supporting schedules.

exhibits.label: Burdened-labor schedule — one week unpaid at quarter end (ties TB 2100)

tasks.prompt: Compute net income to be closed: operating income less interest, taxed at 21%.
Record the accrual for one week of unpaid burdened payroll at quarter end.
tasks.explanation: Dr Cost of contract revenue 148,216 / Cr Accrued payroll & burden 148,216 (= base 108,080 + burden 40,136). Ties to TB 2100.
Dr Depreciation expense 80,000 / Cr Accumulated depreciation 80,000. Accumulated depreciation rolls to (520,000).

tasks.prompt: From the WIP cutoff, compute the NET over/under-billing (contract liability less contract asset) and state which way it nets.
tasks.explanation: 310,000 billings-in-excess (contract liability, acct 2200) − 120,000 costs-in-excess (contract asset, acct 1200) = 190,000 NET OVERBILLED — a liability, meaning the company has billed ahead of revenue earned.

tasks.prompt: Close net income to retained earnings and compute ending retained earnings.
tasks.explanation: Dr Income summary 173,800 / Cr Retained earnings 173,800. Ending RE = 345,284 + 173,800 = 519,084. The closed balance sheet ties: total assets 3,752,300 = total liabilities + equity 3,752,300.

tasks.prompt: Write a 4-5 sentence close checklist confirming the period is ready to report.
tasks.explanation: Confirm: bank reconciled; AR/AP agings tie to control accounts (1,180,000 / 865,000); payroll accrued (148,216); depreciation booked (80,000); WIP cutoff recorded (net 190,000 overbilled); debt split current/long-term; net income (173,800) closed to retained earnings (519,084); and total assets (3,752,300) equal total liabilities plus equity.

outputArtifact: The four period-end adjusting/closing entries (payroll 148,216; depreciation 80,000; WIP net 190,000 overbilled; close 173,800 to RE), ending retained earnings of 519,084, and a proved closed trial balance (assets = L+E = 3,752,300).

conversationSim.prompt: The outside CPA asks: 'Walk me through your close — what adjustments did you book and does the balance sheet tie?' Draft a 3-4 sentence answer.
conversationSim.modelAnswer: We accrued one week of unpaid burdened payroll of $148,216 to account 2100, booked $80,000 of Q1 depreciation, and recorded the WIP cutoff — $120,000 contract asset and $310,000 contract liability, net $190,000 overbilled. Net income of $173,800 closed to retained earnings, taking them from $345,284 to $519,084. The closed balance sheet ties: total assets of $3,752,300 equal total liabilities plus equity, and both agings reconcile to their control accounts.
